sub_indicators.label: Regional cooperation on digital policy
sub_indicators.subject: gov.regional
sub_indicators.text: Regional policy collaboration: regional cooperation on digital policy
sub_indicators.norm_short: The African Union's Digital Transformation Strategy for Africa asks member states to coordinate their digital policies through the Union and its regional communities. Its policy and regulation initiative, PRIDA, is the working track.
criteria: A source from the past three years says the country is suspended from, has left or stands outside the African bodies that make digital policy, and no agreement is on record.

The country belongs to an African body that makes digital policy, or takes part in its meetings, and nothing more is on record. Membership of the African Union or a regional community alone does not count.

In the past three years the country has signed a digital agreement or declaration with another African government or African body, hosted or chaired a meeting of such a body, or won a seat or office in one. Talks, visits and meetings attended do not count.

Something the country agreed has been put into effect: roaming charges cut with a neighbour, a joint body set up and meeting, a regional guideline adopted as a national rule, or a shared service opened.

What was put into effect is reported in use in the past three years: published figures of its use, a decision of the joint body, or a review of what the agreement delivered. A launch, a renewal or projects agreed do not reach this stage.
